decisions.reason: The Greek verb is used for putting out a fire, as the meaning decision says; both Amharic verbs are used of fire, "ማዳፈን" for smothering embers.

source.text: πάντα δὲ δοκιμάζετε, τὸ καλὸν κατέχετε, ἀπὸ παντὸς εἴδους πονηροῦ ἀπέχεσθε.

records.literal_gloss: All [things] but test, the good hold fast, \v 22 from every form of evil abstain.

en.L: But test everything; hold fast to what is good; \v 22 abstain from every form of evil.
en.B: Test everything; keep hold of what is good; \v 22 stay away from evil in every form.
en.R: But test everything to see if it is true. Keep what is good. \v 22 Stay away from every kind of evil.

fr.L: Mais examinez toutes choses ; retenez ce qui est bon ; \v 22 abstenez-vous de toute forme de mal.
fr.B: Examinez tout ; gardez ce qui est bon ; \v 22 tenez-vous à l’écart du mal sous toutes ses formes.
fr.R: Mais examinez tout pour voir si c’est vrai. Gardez ce qui est bon. \v 22 Évitez toute sorte de mal.

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:examínenlo|examinadlo}} todo; {{plural_you:retengan|retened}} lo bueno; \v 22 {{plural_you:apártense|apartaos}} de toda forma de mal.
es.B: {{plural_you:Examínenlo|Examinadlo}} todo; {{plural_you:aférrense|aferraos}} a lo bueno; \v 22 {{plural_you:aléjense|alejaos}} del mal en todas sus formas.
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:pónganlo|ponedlo}} todo a prueba para ver si es verdad. {{plural_you:Quédense|Quedaos}} con lo bueno. \v 22 {{plural_you:Aléjense|Alejaos}} de toda clase de mal.

sw.L: Lakini kila kitu kipimeni, kilicho chema kishikeni kwa nguvu, \v 22 kila namna ya uovu iepukeni.
sw.B: Pimeni kila jambo; shikilieni yaliyo mema; \v 22 kaeni mbali na uovu wa aina yoyote.
sw.R: Lakini pimeni kila jambo ili kuona kama ni la kweli. Shikeni lililo jema. \v 22 Kaeni mbali na kila aina ya uovu.

ko.L: 그러나 모든 것을 시험하여, 좋은 것을 굳게 붙잡고, \v 22 모든 모양의 악을 멀리하십시오.
ko.B: 모든 것을 시험해 보십시오. 좋은 것은 붙잡으십시오. \v 22 어떤 모양의 악이든 멀리하십시오.
ko.R: 그러나 모든 것을 시험해 보아서 그것이 참된지 확인하십시오. 좋은 것은 지키십시오. \v 22 어떤 종류의 악이든 멀리하십시오.

vi.L: Nhưng hãy thử nghiệm mọi sự; hãy giữ lấy điều tốt; \v 22 hãy tránh mọi hình thức của điều ác.
vi.B: Hãy thử nghiệm mọi sự; hãy giữ chặt điều tốt; \v 22 hãy tránh xa điều ác dưới mọi hình thức.
vi.R: Nhưng hãy thử nghiệm mọi điều xem có thật không. Hãy giữ lấy điều tốt. \v 22 Hãy tránh xa mọi thứ điều ác.

pt.L: Mas examinem tudo; retenham o que é bom; \v 22 abstenham-se de toda forma de mal.
pt.B: Ponham tudo à prova; fiquem com o que é bom; \v 22 afastem-se do mal em todas as suas formas.
pt.R: Mas examinem tudo para ver se é verdade. Fiquem com o que é bom. \v 22 Fiquem longe de todo tipo de mal.

am.L: ሁሉን ግን ፈትኑ፤ መልካሙን ያዙ፤ \v 22 ከክፉ ነገር መልክ ሁሉ ራቁ።
am.B: ሁሉን ፈትኑ፤ መልካም የሆነውን አጥብቃችሁ ያዙ፤ \v 22 ከማንኛውም ዓይነት ክፉ ነገር ራቁ።
am.R: ነገር ግን እውነት መሆኑን ለማወቅ ሁሉን ፈትኑ። መልካም የሆነውን ያዙ። \v 22 ከማንኛውም ዓይነት ክፋት ራቁ።

decisions.choice: test everything: especially prophecies
decisions.reason: δὲ ("but") ties the testing to verse 20: prophecy is not to be despised, but weighed (1 Corinthians 14:29; 1 John 4:1). δοκιμάζω is the word for testing metal.

decisions.choice: every form of evil: evil of any kind
alternatives: every appearance of evil: anything that looks bad
decisions.reason: εἴδους means form or kind. The command is to keep from evil in whatever shape it comes, not merely from what might look wrong to others.

decisions.choice: test everything to see if it is true
decisions.reason: Readable says what testing is for (m1).

source.text: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης ἁγιάσαι ὑμᾶς ὁλοτελεῖς, καὶ ὁλόκληρον ὑμῶν τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ ἡ ψυχὴ καὶ τὸ σῶμα ἀμέμπτως ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τηρηθείη.

records.literal_gloss: Himself now the God of the peace may sanctify you wholly, and entire your the spirit and the soul and the body blamelessly at the coming of the Lord of us Jesus Christ may be kept.

en.L: Now may the God of peace {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} sanctify you completely, and may your whole spirit and soul and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: May the God of peace {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} make you holy in every part, and may your spirit, soul and body be kept whole and blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: We pray that God, who gives us peace, will make you holy in every way. We pray that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will keep all of you, your spirit, your soul and your body, without fault until our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} comes back.

fr.L: Or que le Dieu de la paix {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} vous sanctifie entièrement, et que votre esprit, votre âme et votre corps soient gardés tout entiers, irréprochables, lors de la venue de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.B: Que le Dieu de la paix {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} vous rende saints tout entiers, et que votre esprit, votre âme et votre corps soient gardés intacts et irréprochables lors de la venue de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}.
fr.R: Nous prions pour que Dieu, qui nous donne la paix, vous rende saints en tout. Nous prions pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous garde tout entiers, votre esprit, votre âme et votre corps, sans aucun défaut jusqu’au retour de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}.

es.L: Y que el mismo Dios de la paz {{plural_you:los|os}} santifique por completo, y que todo {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} ser, espíritu, alma y cuerpo, sea guardado irreprochable en la venida de nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.
es.B: Que el mismo Dios de la paz {{plural_you:los|os}} haga santos en todo, y que {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} espíritu, alma y cuerpo sean guardados enteros e irreprochables en la venida de nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.
es.R: Pedimos que Dios, que nos da la paz, {{plural_you:los|os}} haga santos en todo sentido. Pedimos que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:los|os}} guarde por completo, en espíritu, alma y cuerpo, sin falta hasta que nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} vuelva.

sw.L: Basi Mungu wa amani {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} awatakase ninyi kwa ukamilifu wote, na roho yenu na nafsi na mwili, vikiwa kamili bila kupungua kitu, vihifadhiwe bila lawama katika kuja kwa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Mungu wa amani {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} awafanye watakatifu kikamilifu, na roho yenu, nafsi yenu na mwili wenu vilindwe vizima na bila lawama wakati wa kuja kwa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: Tunaomba kwamba Mungu, anayetupa amani, awafanye watakatifu kwa kila namna. Tunaomba awalinde ninyi wote, roho zenu, nafsi zenu na miili yenu, bila kosa lolote mpaka Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} atakaporudi.

ko.L: 평안의 하나님 그분이 여러분을 온전히 거룩하게 하시고, 여러분의 영과 혼과 몸이 온전하게 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 오실 때에 흠 없이 지켜지기를 [빕니다].
ko.B: 평안의 하나님 그분이 여러분을 모든 면에서 거룩하게 해 주시고, 여러분의 영과 혼과 몸을 온전하고 흠 없이 지켜 주셔서, 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 오실 때를 맞게 하시기를 빕니다.
ko.R: 우리에게 평안을 주시는 하나님께서 여러분을 모든 면에서 거룩하게 해 주시기를 기도합니다. 그리고 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 다시 오실 때까지, 하나님께서 여러분의 영과 혼과 몸, 곧 여러분의 모든 것을 흠 없이 지켜 주시기를 기도합니다.

vi.L: Nguyện chính Đức Chúa Trời của sự bình an làm cho anh chị em nên thánh trọn vẹn, và nguyện toàn thể tâm linh, linh hồn và thân thể của anh chị em được giữ không chỗ trách được khi Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} đến.
vi.B: Nguyện chính Đức Chúa Trời của sự bình an làm cho anh chị em nên thánh trong mọi phương diện, và nguyện tâm linh, linh hồn và thân thể của anh chị em được giữ trọn vẹn và không chỗ trách được khi Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} đến.
vi.R: Chúng tôi cầu xin Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng ban bình an cho chúng ta, làm cho anh chị em nên thánh trong mọi phương diện. Chúng tôi cầu xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} gìn giữ trọn con người anh chị em, cả tâm linh, linh hồn và thân thể, không có lỗi gì cho đến khi Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} trở lại.

pt.L: E que o Deus da paz, {{deity_pronoun:ele mesmo|Ele mesmo}}, santifique vocês completamente, e que o espírito e a alma e o corpo de vocês, inteiros, sejam conservados irrepreensíveis na vinda do nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}.
pt.B: Que o Deus da paz, {{deity_pronoun:ele mesmo|Ele mesmo}}, santifique vocês por inteiro, e que o espírito, a alma e o corpo de vocês sejam conservados íntegros e sem culpa na vinda do nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}.
pt.R: Oramos para que Deus, que nos dá paz, torne vocês santos em tudo. Oramos para que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} guarde vocês por inteiro, o espírito, a alma e o corpo de vocês, sem culpa até que o nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} volte.

am.L: የሰላም አምላክ ራሱ ፈጽሞ ይቀድሳችሁ፤ መንፈሳችሁ፣ ነፍሳችሁና ሰውነታችሁም ሁሉ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} መምጣት ያለ ነቀፋ ሙሉ ሆነው ይጠበቁ።
am.B: የሰላም አምላክ ራሱ በሁለንተናችሁ ይቀድሳችሁ፤ መንፈሳችሁ፣ ነፍሳችሁና ሰውነታችሁም በጌታችን በኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} መምጣት ሙሉና ያለ ነቀፋ ሆነው ይጠበቁ።
am.R: ሰላምን የሚሰጠን እግዚአብሔር በሁሉ ነገር ቅዱሳን እንዲያደርጋችሁ እንጸልያለን። ጌታችን ኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ተመልሶ እስኪመጣ ድረስ መንፈሳችሁን፣ ነፍሳችሁንና ሰውነታችሁን፣ ሁለንተናችሁን ያለ ነቀፋ እንዲጠብቅ እንጸልያለን።

decisions.choice: the God of peace: the God who gives peace and wholeness
decisions.reason: Peace here is the wholeness God gives, as in the Hebrew shalom (Romans 15:33).

decisions.choice: completely, entire: every part of you, and nothing missing
decisions.reason: ὁλοτελεῖς means complete through and through; ὁλόκληρον whole, with no part lacking. Both stress the whole person.

decisions.choice: spirit, soul and body: the whole person
alternatives: three separate parts of human nature
decisions.reason: Paul lists the parts to say "all of you", not to give a technical account of human nature. Elsewhere he speaks of body and spirit (1 Corinthians 7:34).

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: God, who gives us peace
decisions.reason: Readable says what "God of peace" means (m1).

decisions.choice: todo {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} ser, espíritu, alma y cuerpo
alternatives: su espíritu entero, el alma y el cuerpo
decisions.reason: The Greek adjective "whole" stands before the three nouns; Spanish says it with "todo su ser" and then lists the three, so that "entero" does not seem to go with the spirit only.

decisions.choice: roho, nafsi, mwili
decisions.reason: Swahili has three ordinary words for the three Greek ones, so the list stays whole at every level: "roho" (spirit), "nafsi" (soul, self) and "mwili" (body), together the whole person (meaning decision). "Roho" is lowercase here for the human spirit.

decisions.choice: "평안의 하나님" (L, B); "평안을 주시는 하나님" (R)
decisions.reason: The God who gives peace and wholeness (the meaning decision): the key-term word "평안", as in Philippians 4:9.

decisions.choice: "영과 혼과 몸" at every level
decisions.reason: Spirit, soul and body name the whole person (the meaning decision). "혼" is the established word beside "영"; Readable adds "여러분의 모든 것", as the English Readable says "all of you".

decisions.choice: "tâm linh, linh hồn và thân thể"
decisions.reason: Spirit, soul and body name the whole person (m3). "Tâm linh", lowercase, is the human spirit, as in the Vietnamese Colossians (2:5), and "linh hồn" the soul; "thần, hồn và thể" is a learned formula.

decisions.choice: "chính Đức Chúa Trời", with no pronoun span
decisions.reason: As in 3:11, Vietnamese stresses "God himself" with "chính" before the noun.

decisions.choice: የሰላም አምላክ (the God of peace, L, B); ሰላምን የሚሰጠን እግዚአብሔር (God, who gives us peace, R)
decisions.reason: "God" with a genitive that describes him takes "አምላክ", as in Romans 15:33 and 16:20.

decisions.choice: መንፈስ, ነፍስ, ሰውነት (spirit, soul, body)
decisions.reason: The three words name the whole person, as the meaning decision says; "ሰውነት" is the body, kept apart from "ሥጋ" (flesh), as in Romans.

ko.B: 여러분을 부르시는 하나님은 믿을 수 있는 분이십니다. 그분이 그 일을 이루실 것입니다.

am.L: የሚጠራችሁ ታማኝ [ነው]፤ እርሱም ደግሞ ያደርገዋል።

decisions.choice: the one who calls you: God, who goes on calling
decisions.reason: The present καλῶν describes God as the one who calls (2:12). What he has begun he will complete (Philippians 1:6).

decisions.choice: The God who calls you (B); God, who calls you (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God (m1).

decisions.choice: "신실하시다" (L, R); "믿을 수 있는 분" (B)
decisions.reason: The adjective is from the family of "믿음"; said of God it means faithful, as in Romans 3:3. "미쁘다" is older church language.

decisions.choice: "thành tín" (L, R); "đáng tin cậy" (B)
decisions.reason: Said of God, the Vietnamese Romans uses "thành tín" for his faithfulness to his word (3:3); "trung tín" is kept for faithful people.

decisions.choice: é fiel
decisions.reason: The English Balanced says "can be trusted" because "faithful" can sound churchy in English; Portuguese "fiel" is the everyday word for someone who keeps his word, so Balanced keeps it.

decisions.choice: a holy kiss: the greeting of family
decisions.reason: A kiss was a greeting among relatives and close friends. Believers greeted one another this way as members of one family, and called it "holy" (Romans 16:16; 1 Corinthians 16:20).

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}

decisions.reason: The holy kiss was the greeting of family (m1), here of God's family. Literal and Balanced keep it as the Greek has it; Readable says whose family, as the English Readable does.

decisions.reason: ἐνορκίζω is to put someone under oath. The singular "I" is Paul himself, perhaps taking the pen for the end of the letter.

decisions.choice: read to all: read aloud to the whole church
decisions.reason: Letters were read aloud in the assembly (Colossians 4:16). Paul wants every member to hear it, perhaps including those who were not keeping in step (verse 14).

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "to all the brothers"
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts add "holy". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: The letter is to the whole church, women and men; "brothers" stays available as the traditional form.

decisions.choice: I order you, in the name of the Lord
alternatives: I adjure you by the Lord
decisions.reason: Readable puts the oath in plain words (m1).

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:les|os}} conjuro
decisions.reason: The verb puts the readers under oath (meaning decision); "conjurar" is the Spanish verb for charging someone by a solemn oath.

decisions.choice: መልእክት (letter, epistle, L, B); ደብዳቤ (letter, R)
decisions.reason: "መልእክት" is the word Amharic readers know for an apostle's letter; Readable uses the everyday "ደብዳቤ", as in its opening of the letter.
